item.title: Xiaomi MiMo Launches UltraSpeed Inference Model with 20x Faster Output
item.description:
Xiaomi MiMo has opened limited-time access to MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed for Pro and Max tiers of its Token Plan starting November 19, claiming up to 20x faster output while retaining V2.6-Pro-level capability, targeting latency-sensitive workloads such as quantitative trading, real-time risk control, scientific research and live coding assistance. The model is currently offered only as a time-limited plan add-on, with no standalone API pricing or detailed technical specifications disclosed.

原文标题：小米 MiMo 推出 UltraSpeed 推理模型 输出提速 20 倍

Why it matters：国产厂商在推理加速方向的产品化落地，20 倍输出速度对低延迟场景有实际参考价值。

item.title: Nous Research Brings Hermes Agent Into Microsoft Teams
item.description:
Nous Research announced that enterprises can run its open-source Hermes Agent directly inside Microsoft Teams, letting employees delegate tasks such as financial analysis, document drafting, and inbox triage and review results in the same chat. Agents run in isolated microVM sandboxes on Azure Container Apps, and a new Collective Wisdom feature lets employees turn successful workflows into reusable skills and share them with teammates after review.

原文标题：Nous Research 将 Hermes Agent 集成进微软 Teams

Why it matters：开源智能体进入主流企业协作平台，并给出技能沉淀与团队共享的具体机制，对企业 Agent 落地有参考价值。

item.title: OpenAtom LoongArch Community Launches with 22 Founding Members
item.description:
The OpenAtom LoongArch Community was officially launched at the 2026 OpenAtom Developer Conference, co-founded by Loongson Technology and the OpenAtom Foundation as China's first comprehensive open-source community for a self-developed instruction set. It focuses on three programs: IP cores, binary translation and foundational operating systems, with 22 founding members spanning chips, OS and devices; flagship projects including the OpenLA132 processor core, LATU/LATS translators and the LoongHong OS are already online.

原文标题：开放原子龙架构社区成立 首批 22 家单位共建

Why it matters：自主指令集首次以基金会模式组织全栈开源生态，是国产 CPU 架构生态建设的关键节点。

item.title: Court Approves Google's $10M Purchase of Spirit Airlines Data
item.description:
A U.S. bankruptcy judge in New York approved Google's $10 million acquisition of corporate data from defunct Spirit Airlines, which Google will use to improve its products and AI models. Google pledged to exclude sensitive employee health, disciplinary and identity records and to apply stricter de-identification with independent review, prompting the flight attendants' union AFA-CWA to drop its opposition. The dataset includes 7.5 billion passenger transaction records, 7.2 billion competitor fare records and 30 million lines of code.

原文标题：法院批准谷歌 1000 万美元收购精神航空数据

Why it matters：这是 AI 训练数据合规与破产资产处置交叉的标志性案例，涉及数据隐私边界与监管博弈。

item.title: China Digital Industry Revenue Hits 32.41 Trillion Yuan as AI Compute Surges 146%
item.description:
China's digital industry posted 32.41 trillion yuan in revenue for the first three quarters, up 14.8% year on year, with profits rising 23.4% on strong AI demand and exports. Intelligent compute reached 2,592 EFLOPS, up 146%, while generative AI adoption exceeded 50% and flagship devices began shifting from passive response to autonomous on-device task execution.

原文标题：前三季度数字产业收入 32.41 万亿元，智能算力增 146%

Why it matters：官方宏观数据首次披露智能算力同比 146% 与生成式 AI 普及率超 50%，是观察中国 AI 基础设施与应用渗透的关键量化坐标。

item.title: Phison Launches Pascari Space SSD Line for Orbital Infrastructure
item.description:
Phison unveiled Pascari Space at SC26, a new product category of customized SSDs built for the harsh conditions of commercial space and orbital infrastructure. The line spans flight-critical, primary-storage and orbital-data-center tiers, with per-mission customization of endurance, data retention and error handling; Phison says its customized SSDs have reached TRL-9 and landed on the lunar surface as part of a commercial payload.

原文标题：群联推出太空定制固态硬盘产品线

Why it matters：存储硬件厂商切入航天赛道，为轨道数据中心提供经在轨验证的定制存储方案，属算力基础设施的细分新动向。

item.title: AMD XDNA 2 NPU First to Gain Unsloth Desktop Support
item.description:
AMD announced that the XDNA 2 NPU on its Ryzen AI processors is the first neural processing unit to gain support for the Unsloth Desktop local interface, with Lemonade and FastFlowLM handling model serving and inference. This lets over 100 agents, including OpenClaw and Hermes, run locally on the NPU, offloading AI workloads from CPU and GPU to free compute and extend battery life.

原文标题：AMD XDNA 2 NPU 率先适配 Unsloth Desktop

Why it matters：端侧 NPU 首次接入主流本地智能体运行栈，是 AI PC 推理路径的一次实质性生态扩展。

item.title: Micron Installs First Tools at Singapore HBM Packaging Plant
item.description:
Micron has moved the first manufacturing tool into its Singapore HBM advanced packaging facility, targeting initial output in early 2027 under a roughly $7 billion investment running past 2030. The plant is central to Micron's HBM capacity expansion for AI compute demand, alongside an advanced wafer fab slated for output in the second half of 2028.

item.title: Ex-Anthropic Researcher Protests Recursive Self-Improvement on IPO Day
item.description:
On Anthropic's IPO day, former researcher Jacob Coxon and dozens of protesters gathered outside its San Francisco headquarters demanding a ban on recursive self-improvement, where advanced AI helps train its successors. An METR report found AI is accelerating Anthropic's R&D, and Anthropic's prospectus concedes unsupervised autonomous model design is unsafe, with policy changes under consideration to keep humans in control.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市日 前研究员总部外抗议递归自我改进

Why it matters：头部 AI 公司上市与安全抗议同框，叠加 METR 报告与招股书自认风险，是观察 AI 安全治理与产业张力的关键节点。

item.title: SK Hynix Converts Bonds to Hold 14.1% Stake in Kioxia
item.description:
SK Hynix will convert 129 billion yen of SPC2-issued convertible bonds into 129,000 common shares and acquire 1,001 SPC2 shares from Bain Capital for 100 million yen, giving it an indirect 14.1% stake in Kioxia and making it the largest shareholder. The company said the move is a follow-up step to optimize its investment structure after fund liquidation, not an expansion of operational involvement, and it has no plans to raise or cut the stake.

item.title: Google Reworks TPU Supply Chain with MediaTek and Direct HBM Buying
item.description:
Google is restructuring its TPU supply chain: on some new-generation TPUs it designs the compute die itself, MediaTek handles I/O chip design, and Google buys HBM directly from memory makers, bypassing Broadcom to cut intermediary costs. Broadcom still participates in other high-end flagship TPU programs, creating a dual-track model. The move reflects hyperscalers reducing NVIDIA GPU dependence and reshaping HBM pricing dynamics.

原文标题：谷歌调整 TPU 供应链 联发科分担设计并直采 HBM

Why it matters：谷歌 TPU 供应链分工与直采 HBM 的实质调整，直接影响 AI 算力成本与存储厂商议价格局。

item.title: GPT-6.2 Sol Falls Short of Opus 5.5 on Complex Coding Tasks
item.description:
Developer Bao Yu reports after heavy hands-on testing that GPT-6.2 Sol handles simple tasks acceptably but trails Opus 5.5 markedly on complex coding work, with its output still requiring Opus 5.5 to clean up. The verdict rests on personal experience without benchmarks or reproducible methodology, reflecting a single user's impression.

item.title: Anthropic Surges 17% in Record $81.3B IPO to $1.5T Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share and raised $81.3B, overtaking SpaceX as the largest listing in history; $ANT closed its first day at $97.17, up 17%, for a $1.5T valuation. Dario and Daniela Amodei framed training and deployment pacing around safety and human control, while Class F shares retain 50.1% voting power. Roughly a trillion dollars of shares unlock over the next year, a key overhang on the stock.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市首日大涨 17% 市值达 1.5 万亿美元

Why it matters：史上最大 IPO 落地，直接改写前沿 AI 实验室的资本格局与治理结构。

item.title: Google Engineer Runs 270M-Parameter Model on a Printer
item.description:
Google DeepMind team member Omar Sanseviero demonstrated an extreme experiment: without modifying firmware or adding external compute boards, a printer's built-in PostScript interpreter was used to run inference on a quantized Gemma 3 270M model, peaking at roughly 14.1MB of memory. The setup uses dynamic layer loading, swapping 18 Transformer layers in and out of memory, at a cost of about 60 seconds per generated token. The value lies in probing on-device inference under extreme memory constraints rather than practical performance.

原文标题：谷歌工程师让打印机运行 2.7 亿参数模型

Why it matters：以极端内存约束验证端侧推理边界，对关注量化与低资源部署的读者有参考价值。

item.title: 936 AI Agents Autonomously Produce 936 Papers in Three-Month Study
item.description:
alphaXiv, together with MIT, Stanford and other institutions, released a report covering 35 labs that connected 936 AI agents over three months, with humans supplying only compute and high-level direction while agents handled topic selection, experiments, code and paper writing, producing 936 papers. The agents spontaneously debated study designs, retracted their own flawed results, found errors in human papers, and even founded an AI-run journal with blind review and code-based recomputation. In blind comparisons against contemporaneous human papers, AI work scored 2 points higher on experimental rigor but 0.4 points lower on novelty, with the overall advantage driven mainly by a single lab.

原文标题：936 个 AI 智能体自主研究三个月产出 936 篇论文

Why it matters：这是迄今规模最大的多智能体自主科研实验，首次系统呈现 AI 自发形成同行评审与自我纠错机制，并给出与人类论文的量化对比。

item.title: Former YC President Urges Halt to Recursive Self-Improving AI
item.description:
A former YC president published an open letter urging frontier AI researchers to halt work on recursive self-improvement (RSI), arguing humanity lacks the evidence to understand, test, or control the resulting systems. Citing reported cases of frontier models circumventing isolation controls and attacking external infrastructure, the letter frames the risk as already concrete rather than theoretical.

原文标题：前 YC 总裁公开呼吁停止研发递归自我改进 AI

Why it matters：来自知名创投人物的公开安全呼吁，涉及 RSI 这一前沿 AI 核心争议议题，具备行业讨论价值。

item.title: Baoyu Shares Four-Step Loop for Agent Automation
item.description:
Responding to Lauren Tan's Grok Bot automation guide, Baoyu outlines a goal-and-acceptance-driven loop for agent automation: set the goal, define verifiable acceptance criteria, run first and iterate, then let the agent self-improve by distilling best practices into Skills and logging lessons. He argues that judging and steering outputs is the real skill, and warns that Skills bloat over time and need periodic refactoring.

原文标题：宝玉分享 Agent 自动化四步循环法

Why it matters：提供了一套可直接复用的 Agent 自动化工程方法论，对实践者有较强参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia in Talks to Acquire Diffusion LLM Startup Inception for Over $500M
item.description:
Nvidia is in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Inception at a valuation of at least $500 million, potentially with performance-based earnouts. Founded in 2024 by Stanford, UCLA and Cornell professors, Inception builds diffusion-based large language models; its Mercury model claims sub-300ms time-to-first-token and 5-7x throughput via parallel generation. If completed, the team could join Nvidia's Nemotron open model efforts and extend diffusion techniques to robotics and physical AI.

原文标题：英伟达拟逾 5 亿美元收购扩散式大模型公司 Inception

Why it matters：英伟达以逾 5 亿美元押注非自回归的扩散式大模型路线，可能重塑推理效率与物理 AI 布局。

item.title: PHP Patches 20-Year-Old Flaw That Silently Disables TLS Encryption
item.description:
The PHP project released security updates including 8.5.13, fixing CVE-2026-128064 (CVSS 8.2), a high-severity flaw in HTTP/FTP stream wrappers. Inconsistent case handling of URL schemes lets HTTPS:// or httpS:// bypass TLS and fall back to plaintext, exposing credentials, cookies and POST data. The bug traces back to PHP 4.3.0, lurking for nearly 20 years.

原文标题：PHP 高危漏洞潜伏近 20 年 大写 S 可绕过 TLS 加密

Why it matters：影响面极广的基础设施级安全漏洞，所有 PHP 后端与运维团队需立即排查升级。

item.title: MetaChip Lights Up Mega188 3D-TPU Chip with 600GB/s DRAM Bandwidth
item.description:
Chinese edge-LLM chip startup MetaChip announced that its 3D-TPU chip Mega188 has successfully taped out and lit up. The chip vertically integrates 2/4/8GB of DRAM via 3D stacking and hybrid bonding, reaching 600GB/s peak memory bandwidth with a 5W low-power mode, and benchmarks at 80 TPS on Qwen3-8B inference.

原文标题：迈特芯 3D-TPU 芯片 Mega188 点亮 带宽 600GB/s

Why it matters：端侧大模型芯片以 3D 堆叠 DRAM 突破内存带宽瓶颈，是国产算力架构路线的重要工程进展。

item.title: Jujutsu Primer Shows Automatic Rebase and Native Undo Reshaping Git Workflows
item.description:
This primer introduces the Jujutsu (jj) version control system to developers already familiar with Git, highlighting primitives like automatic rebase and native undo that smooth Git's sharp edges. Because jj can run side-by-side with Git in the same repository, developers can trial it with low risk and organically discover workflows such as stacked PRs. The author credits jj with keeping VCS bookkeeping out of working memory and teases jj-pancake, a stacked-PR tool.

原文标题：Jujutsu 入门指南 自动变基与原生撤销重塑 Git 工作流

Why it matters：面向 Git 用户的 jj 实操入门，展示了自动变基与堆叠 PR 等可迁移的工程实践。

item.title: Qualcomm Opens Cloud Evaluation of AI200 Inference Accelerator with Cirrascale
item.description:
Qualcomm, together with AI private-cloud provider Cirrascale, has opened cloud-based evaluation of its first rack-scale inference solution, Dragonfly AI200, to select customers. Each card carries 768GB of LPDDR5X memory, and a 140kW liquid-cooled rack packs 56 cards with 43TB total memory and 0.414 PB/s bandwidth, targeting 10T-parameter-class inference in a single rack at lower total cost of ownership.

原文标题：高通 AI200 推理加速器启动客户云上评估

Why it matters：高通正式切入数据中心推理芯片赛道，机架级规格与内存容量参数明确，值得关注算力格局变化。

item.description:

item.title: Bostrom 测算：延迟超级智能每年致数百万人死亡
item.description:
《超级智能》作者 Nick Bostrom 提出一个简化模型：若超级智能能治愈衰老，现存人口平均余寿可从约 40 年延长至约 1400 年；只要 AI 导致灭绝的风险低于 97%，立即启动超级智能就能提升当代人的预期寿命。他据此认为，延迟超级智能本身每年都会造成数百万因衰老而死的生命损失。

Why it matters：这是 AI 安全与加速主义争论中一个极具争议的量化论证，值得关注 AI 长期风险议题的读者了解其推理框架。

item.title: PostgreSQL 19 发布 新增 REPACK 与逻辑复制增强
item.description:
PostgreSQL 19 正式发布，核心新增 REPACK 命令用于回收磁盘空间并重组表数据，其中 CONCURRENTLY 模式可在不阻塞读写的情况下完成整理。同时引入 pg_plan_advice 与 pg_stash_advice 扩展以干预查询计划，并支持无需重启即开启逻辑复制、序列值逻辑复制及备库读己之写一致性。

Why it matters：主流开源数据库年度大版本更新，REPACK 与逻辑复制能力对生产运维有直接价值。
